title: The Nihilist Reading Of Wolf's Rain #Shorts
description:
Meaning is not found in Wolf's Rain — it is manufactured for it. Wolf's Rain (stylized in all caps) is a Japanese anime television series created by writer Keiko Nobumoto and produced by Bones. It was directed by Tensai Okamura and featured character designs by Toshihiro Kawamoto with a soundtrack produced and arranged by Yoko Kanno.

Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Wolf's Rain shows exactly where that breaks. Rough and self-reliant, Tsume is a strong fighter who keeps his true feelings to himself. He does not initially believe in Paradise, but eventually starts to believe in their goal after seeing the great sacrifices his new pack was doing in order to open Paradise.
